meta.java_version: 26.3 (released 2026-09-15); ja_jp.json has the same hash in 26.4-snapshot-1
meta.anvil_cost_note: anvil_cost is the item multiplier. The book multiplier is max(1, floor(anvil_cost / 2)). The wikis list Loyalty as 1 / 1, but its anvil_cost in the game data is 2.

sweeping_edge.bedrock_note: Java Edition only; it does not exist in Bedrock Edition.

wither_skeleton_skull.ja: ウィザースケルトンの頭蓋骨

mob_head.notes: The generic name Mobの頭 is the wiki article title; the article also gives the Bedrock Edition name モブの頭蓋骨. Accepts only Curse of Binding and Curse of Vanishing.

prior_work_penalty.note: A term from the ja.minecraft.wiki article on anvil mechanics, not a string shown in the game. Penalty = 2^(anvil use count) - 1. The wiki does not use 累積作業ペナルティ.

anvil_use_count.en: anvil use count (number of prior anvil uses)
anvil_use_count.note: Number of anvil operations so far; every operation except renaming adds 1. The stored value is the repair_cost component (formerly the RepairCost NBT tag), which holds the prior work penalty itself.

total_cost.note: Prior work penalty + base cost. In Survival and Adventure, up to 39 levels is allowed and 40 or more is refused as Too Expensive! (English wiki, Anvil mechanics: "Once the cost exceeds 39 levels"). The Japanese wiki's "more than 40" is inaccurate.

too_expensive.note: Java Edition uses the full-width ！ (U+FF01); Bedrock Edition uses the ASCII !.

enchantment_cost.ja: エンチャントのコスト：%1$sレベル
enchantment_cost.ja_bedrock: エンチャントのコスト: %1$d
enchantment_cost.note: Java Edition uses a full-width colon (U+FF1A) and ends with レベル (levels). Bedrock Edition uses an ASCII colon and a space, without レベル.

level_requirement.note: Text on the enchanting table screen.

enchanting_table.ja: エンチャントテーブル

grindstone.screen_title: 修繕・エンチャント除去

experience_level.note: The game (command text) uses 経験値レベル. The ja.minecraft.wiki anvil article also uses 経験レベル in places. Costs are shown as ◯レベル.

max_level.note: Wiki table heading. The game's command error text uses 最高レベル (commands.enchant.failed.level).

incompatible.note: The wiki writes ◯◯と競合する ("conflicts with ◯◯").

treasure_enchantment.ja: トレジャーエンチャント

curse.note: As in Curse of Binding and Curse of Vanishing.

target_item.ja: 左のアイテム（修理対象）
target_item.note: The Japanese wiki says 左にあるアイテム or 左のマス. Japanese has no established term for target and sacrifice.

sacrifice_item.note: The Japanese wiki says 右にあるアイテム and does not use 犠牲 (sacrifice).

rename.note: The in-game screen title is 修繕・名付け. The Japanese wiki anvil article also uses 名称変更.

repair.note: 修繕 is also the name of Mending, so prefer 修理 in the UI.

creative.long: クリエイティブモード

java_edition.note: The Japanese minecraft.net uses Java 版 (with an ASCII space); ja.minecraft.wiki uses Java Edition.

bedrock_edition.note: ja.minecraft.wiki uses Bedrock Edition and notes that it is often called 統合版 in Japan.

enchantment_levels.note: ja_jp also uses the ASCII Roman numerals I to X. In Java Edition, an enchantment whose max level is 1 shows no level. The name and the level are separated by an ASCII space (e.g. ダメージ増加 V).
